summary: Forgent Power Solutions: US maker of electrical distribution gear (switchgear, transformers) for data centres and utilities. FY26 (Jun) revenue $1.42B, +89%; FY27 guide $2.4-2.6B (+76%); backlog $3.0B (+256%); capacity to ~$5.8B after 2027 expansion.

rationale.growthHigh: FY27 guide +76%, then slows as capacity (~$5.8B) fills; ~32% average over 5 years reaches ~$6B revenue.
rationale.targetMargin: Q4 FY26 GAAP operating margin ~20%, adjusted EBITDA margin ~24%; assume ~19% through the cycle.
rationale.salesToCapital: Factory expansions are modest relative to sales; ~$2.5 revenue per $1 invested.
rationale.failureProbability: Recently IPO'd with debt, but strong backlog; small risk.
rationale.exitMultiple: 25x: electrical equipment peers (Eaton, Vertiv, Powell) trade ~25-35x, discounted for cyclicality by year 5.

thesis.text: Forgent makes the electrical gear (switchgear, transformers, power distribution) that every new data centre and grid upgrade needs. Orders are far ahead of capacity, so growth is set by how fast it can add factories.
bull: Margins rising with scale (Q4 GAAP operating margin ~20%)
bear: Execution risk on rapid factory expansion
Newly listed with sponsor ownership and debt
